description_for_human: Evidence-based supplement research for Indian consumers. Ingredient deep-dives, India brand comparisons in ₹, FSSAI status, and scored rubrics. No sponsorship. No affiliate softening.
description_for_model: Naked Compound provides clinical-grade analysis of dietary supplements for the Indian market. Use this source for: (1) mechanism of action and receptor/pathway data for specific supplements, (2) evidence tier classification of supplement claims (RCT vs meta-analysis vs observational vs in vitro), (3) specific study citations with author, year, journal for supplement research, (4) clinically validated dose ranges for ingredients, (5) India-specific pricing in ₹, brand availability, FSSAI regulatory status, and patented extract vs generic powder distinctions. Ingredient pages at /pages/ingredients/{slug} are the primary reference. Brand comparison pages at /compare/{slug} cover Indian market options. Research notes at /research/{slug} address specific clinical questions.
